findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：JCI 商用 HVAC、控制、保全、消防設備與系統主要經由全球直銷通路銷售，另有第三方經銷商通路貢獻大量銷售；10-K 未描述通路結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: The Company sells and installs its commercial HVAC equipment and systems, control systems, security systems, fire-detection and fire suppression systems, equipment and services primarily through its extensive direct channel, consisting of a global 4 network of sales and service offices. Significant sales are also generated through global third-party channels, such as distributors of air-conditioning, controls, security and fire-detection and suppression products.

findings.claim: DEF 14A 提及新董事長/CEO 分離與以 80/20、Lean 建立新營運系統（非通路轉型，僅營運方向）
findings.excerpt: At the same time, the Company is developing and implementing its new proprietary business system — rooted in proven methodologies like 80/20 and Lean, and augmented with the promise of digitization and artificial intelligence.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋兩次未找到 2026 年通路去中介或訂閱化轉型的來源；OpenBlue/recurring revenue 僅見第三方片段，未核原文，不採用。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
